notes: The only miss was `"hello world hello"` → `"helo wrd"` (no trailing `h`). Every other case appends `h`, and every non-appending case contains a lowercase `h` in the deduped result. So the rule is: global dedupe (keep first occurrence), then append `h` only if the result doesn't already contain lowercase `h`. (Uppercase `H` doesn't suppress the append, per E1's `"Hello World..."`.)
